projects.title: Projects
projects.empty_hint: Import a script to start your first project.

design.title: Design system
design.intro: Tokens and status components, for development only.
design.sample_text: Take a breath and say the line.
design.sample_chunk: Take a breath, look into the lens, and say the first line like you mean it.

script.title: Import a script
script.intro: Paste your script, then check what will be read aloud and how it's split. Nothing is recorded or read aloud on this page, and your wording is never changed.
script.source_hint: Headings (#), “Note:” lines, [scene cues], bullets and tables are recognized automatically.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.hint: Only spoken blocks are read aloud. If a block was recognized wrongly, change its type.
blocks.empty: Paste a script to see its blocks.

script.resegment_note: Changing the text, a block type or the chunk size splits the script again and discards boundary edits.

coverage.ok: All spoken text is covered exactly once

chunks.title: Chunks
chunks.hint: Click a word to split before it, drag a boundary onto a word to move it, or merge two chunks. Keyboard: on a chunk, Enter starts a split (arrow keys choose, Enter splits, Escape cancels); on a boundary, arrow keys move it by one word and Delete merges.
chunks.split_mode: Choose where to split: arrow keys move, Enter splits, Escape cancels.

edit_error.not_spoken: Boundaries can only be placed in spoken text.
edit_error.no_boundary_nearby: There's no word start close enough to place a boundary.
edit_error.outside_chunk: A boundary can't move past its neighbours; each chunk needs at least one word.
edit_error.first_chunk: The first chunk has no boundary before it.
edit_error.last_chunk: The last chunk has nothing after it to merge with.

errors.network: The server couldn't be reached. Check that the app is running, then try again.
errors.validation_failed: Some of the data wasn't valid. Please check it and try again.
errors.conflict: This was changed elsewhere. Reload and try again.
errors.local_user_missing: The local user is missing. Run the database seed, then try again.
errors.database_unavailable: The database isn't available. Check the database settings, then try again.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.coverage_violation: The chunks don't cover the spoken text exactly once, so nothing was saved.
errors.stale_update: A newer change was already saved.
errors.range_not_satisfiable: The requested part of the file isn't available.
errors.speech_unavailable: The assistant voice or transcription isn't available right now. Check your connection or the local AI service, then try again.
errors.method_not_allowed: The app sent a request the server doesn't support. Please reload the page and try again.
